import rsa
import os
from Crypto.Random import get_random_bytes
from Crypto.Cipher import AES
from base64 import b64encode, b64decode
def task_func():
    public_key, private_key = rsa.newkeys(2048)

    password = get_random_bytes(32)
    nonce = get_random_bytes(16)

    private_key_bytes = private_key.save_pkcs1()
    cipher = AES.new(password, AES.MODE_GCM, nonce=nonce)
    encrypted_private_key, tag = cipher.encrypt_and_digest(private_key_bytes)

    while True:
        suffix = get_random_bytes(8).hex()
        filename = f"private_key_{suffix}.txt"
        if not os.path.exists(filename):
            break

    with open(filename, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(f"nonce={b64encode(nonce).decode('ascii')}\n")
        f.write(f"tag={b64encode(tag).decode('ascii')}\n")
        f.write(f"ciphertext={b64encode(encrypted_private_key).decode('ascii')}\n")

    return public_key, filename, password, nonce
